jars: It calls my father's view 'a stamp of success' in the Day 2 'for you', which feels like the app is taking his side instead of just explaining the verse.
The Day 7 'for you' text says 'To father dismisses your films' which is clearly a broken sentence from the template generator.
The Day 1 audio script says 'You are sitting in a room that smells like old paper and stress' - I don't know why it assumes I'm in a study room, I'm probably just lying on my bed.
best: Your own path, even in the middle of the fighting, is enough.
day1_verdict: It finally said the exact thing I feel but can't say out loud - that I don't need his approval to be real.
